title: Exact cache-sharing fixed-candidate scorer
scope: A frozen native Arm64 comparison of the E10c /score endpoint against the exact E10b probability_ids primitive on the selected Ministral 3B Q4_K_M runtime. It proves fixed multi-token continuation parity, one-prefix A/B/C/D evaluation, quality outcomes on all 30 retained admission tasks, latency, process CPU, prompt evaluations, response size, readiness, and peak RSS. Both measured modes use the same four-slot service. It is not yet the pinned external holdout or a claim about other optimizations.
hypothesis: On exact patched b10216, /score matches the E10b serial reference within frozen log-probability tolerances and produces identical 30-task predictions while reducing median per-task HTTP latency and CPU seconds by at least 30% and prompt evaluations from four to one.
negative_result_rule: Retain source, build, API, token, prompt-template, parity, prediction, quality, latency, CPU, RSS, readiness, or raw-response failures without changing candidate IDs, multi-token sequences, tasks, ordering, repetitions, tolerances, or promotion gates.

primitive.selection: maximum summed log probability with request-order tie break

workload.candidate_token_identity_source: E10b native manifest; A/B/C/D each tokenized to exactly one distinct token on the selected model

execution.serial_reference: For each task and candidate, request its exact E10b next-token probability with cache_prompt=false. Multi-token calibration appends each forced token to the explicit prompt before scoring the next token.
execution.forked_scorer: One /score request per task with all four explicit candidate token sequences and cache_prompt=false.
execution.raw_response_retention: Every measured and calibration HTTP response is gzip-compressed with byte count and compressed/uncompressed SHA-256.

decision.promote_rule: Promote /score as the reusable exact candidate evaluator only if all source, API, raw-response, parity, prompt-identity, prediction, latency, CPU, evaluation-count, RSS, and readiness gates pass.
decision.next_step_on_pass: Run the already pinned external E9b task selection through this scorer with per-sample logs before using it to qualify additional optimization lanes.
decision.next_step_on_failure: Retain the result, diagnose the failed invariant, and do not use /score for external quality claims.

claim_boundary: A passing E10c proves exact serial-reference parity and measured cache-sharing efficiency for fixed candidate scoring on the selected native Arm64 b10216 four-slot service and the frozen 30-task workload. It does not rewrite the original admission contract, establish independent external-holdout quality, isolate all benefit from four-slot service configuration, or prove energy, PMU, local-device, fleet, many-core, other-model, other-quant, other-runtime, or other-optimization behavior.
